outlook.statement: The Company proposes to commence the manufacturing of soya bean chunks and vermicelli at Krishnagiri District as part of its diversification programme.

The outlook for the FMCG sector remains positive, supported by improving rural demand, gradual urban consumption recovery, expanding digital and quick-commerce channels, and increasing consumer spending. However, the sector is expected to face near-term challenges from volatile raw-material costs, margin pressures, intense competition and changing consumer preferences.

risks: Continuing challenges in the retail trade
Maintain volume growth and consumer affordability while input costs, competition and distribution costs are increasing
Global economic uncertainties, geopolitical developments, commodity price volatility and changes in international trade policies
Volatility in the prices of raw materials, packaging materials, fuel, transportation and other inputs may affect operating costs and margins.
Competition from established FMCG companies, regional players and emerging brands.
Changes in consumer preferences, regulatory requirements, market conditions and product demand may impact operations and financial performance.
Global economic uncertainties, geopolitical developments, international trade policies, adverse weather conditions and supply-chain disruptions may affect availability and cost of raw materials.
Internal financial controls over financial reporting may become inadequate because of changes in conditions or deterioration in compliance with policies/procedures
